diataxis_coverage_ai.description: AI estimate (0-4) of how many Diataxis modes (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation) the documentation covers. Informational only; does not affect medals.

security_ssdlc.label: Security
security_ssdlc.description: Dependency updates and effective default-branch protections.

renovate_enabled.label: Renovate onboarded
renovate_enabled.description: Renovate is set up and active: the repository has a Renovate configuration and an open Dependency Dashboard issue created by the Renovate bot. A configuration file alone does not count.

branch_protection_required_checks.label: Required checks enforced
branch_protection_required_checks.description: The default branch requires status checks to pass before merging, set through branch protection or an active repository or organization ruleset. Protection without required checks, or rulesets in Evaluate mode, do not count.

signed_commits_required.label: Signed commits required
signed_commits_required.description: The default branch requires signed commits, set through branch protection or an active repository or organization ruleset. Rulesets in Evaluate mode do not count.
